spans.s: खंकर m. A curl, a lock of hair.
खंज a. (f. जा) Lame, crippled, M.iii.242, Bhartr.i.64.
खंज a. (f. जा) Lame, crippled, M.iii.242, Bhartr.i.64.
खंज-खेट, -खेल m. the wag-tail.
खंज-खेट, -खेल m. the wag-tail.
खंजन (I) m. A species of the wag-tail, एको हि खंजनवरो नकिनीदलस्थः Sr.
, ये ये खंजनमेकमेव कमले पश्यंति दैवात् क्वचित् Git.G.xi.
खंजन (II) n. Going lamely.
खंजना f. A species of wag-tail.
खंजन-रत n. the co-habitation of saints.
खंजना f. A species of wag-tail.
खंजरीट m. The wag-tail, Bh.V.ii.78, Yaj.i.174, Am.
खंजरीट m. The wag-tail, Bh.V.ii.78, Yaj.i.174, Am.
खंजरीट m. The wag-tail, Bh.V.ii.78, Yaj.i.174, Am.

खंड (I) m.n. 1. A break, a fissure, a fracture; 2. a piece, a fragment, a portion, दिवः कांतिमत्खंडमेकम् Megh.i.30, K.S.vii.48, Sis.ix.9; 3. a section of a work, a chapter; 4. a multitude, an assemblage.
खंड (II) m. 1. Candied sugar; 2. A flaw in a jewel.
खंड (III) n. 1. a kind of salt; 2. a sort of sugar-cane.
खंड-अभ्र n. 1. scattered clouds; 2. the impression of the teeth in amorous sports.
खंड-आली f. 1. a measure of oil; 2. a lake; 3. a woman whose husband has been guilty of infidelity.
खंड-कथा f. a short tale.
खंड-काव्य n. a small poem (खंडकाव्यं भवेत् काव्यस्यैकदेशानुसारि च) e.g. मेघदूत.
खंड-ज m. a kind of sugar.
खंड-धारा f. scissors.
खंड-परशु m. 1. an epithet of Śiva, e.g. महैश्वर्यं लीलाजनितजगतः खंडपरशोः G.
, येनानेन जगत्सु खंडपरशुर्देवो हरः ख्यापते Mv.ii.; 2. an epithet of Paraśurāma, son of Jamadagni.
खंड-पर्शु m. 1. a name of Śiva; 2. of Paraśurāma; 3. of Rāhu; 4. an elephant with a broken tusk.
खंड-पाल m. a confectioner.
खंड-प्रलय m. a partial destruction of the universe in which all the spheres beneath svarga are dissolved in one common ruin.
खंड-मंडल n. a segment of a circle.
खंड-मोदक m. a kind of sugar.
खंड-लवण n. a kind of salt.
खंड-विकार m. sugar.
खंड-शर्करा f. candied sugar.
खंड-शस् ind. 1. bit by bit, piece by piece, piece-meal; 2. into pieces.
खंड-शीला f. a loose woman, an unchaste wife.
खंडक (I) m.n. A fragment, a piece, a part.
खंडक (II) m. 1. Candied sugar; 2. one who has no nails.
खंडन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Breaking, cutting, dividing; 2. destroying, annihilating, स्मरगरलखंडनं मम शिरसि मंडनम् Git.G.x.

खंडन (II) n. 1. Breaking or cutting; 2. biting, injuring, hurting, घटय भुजबंधनं जनय रदखंडनम् Git.G.x., R.xix.31; 3. interrupting, रसखंडनवर्जितम् R.ix.36; 4. cheating, deceiving; 5. refuting, Na.vi.113; 6. rebellion, opposition.
खंडन (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Breaking, cutting, dividing; 2. destroying, annihilating, स्मरगरलखंडनं मम शिरसि मंडनम् Git.G.x.

खंड्य (denom. verb) 1. To cut, to break in pieces, to tear, Bt.xv.54; 2. to destroy, to annihilate, to defeat, रजनीचयनाथेन खंडिते तिमिरे Hit.ii.; 3. to disturb, to influence, e.g. स्त्रीभिः कस्य न खंडितं भुवि मनः Panch.i.
खंडल m.n. A piece.
खंडित a. (f. ता) 1. Cut, broken in pieces; 2. destroyed, annihilated; 3. rebelled; 4. refuted, controverted; 5. betrayed, disappointed.
खंडित a. (f. ता) 1. Cut, broken in pieces; 2. destroyed, annihilated; 3. rebelled; 4. refuted, controverted; 5. betrayed, disappointed.

खंडिता f. One of the eight Nāyikās in Sanskrit poetry. She is described as being angry with her husband for his infidelity; (the S.D. thus describes her- पार्श्वमेति प्रियो यस्या अन्यसंभोगचिह्नितः । सा खंडितेति कथिता धीरैरीर्ष्याकषायिता) R.v.67.
खंडित-विग्रह a. maimed, mutilated.
खंडित-वृत्त a. dissolute, immoral.
खंडिनी f. The earth.

खन् vt. 1U (pp. खात; pass. खन्यते or खायते) To dig up, to delve, to excavate, M.ii.218, Rt.i.17.With अभि-, to dig.With उद्-, to dig out, to root out, to eradicate (lit. and fig.), R.iv.37, Bt.xii.5, xv.55, Megh.i.52, R.iv.33, 36, xiv.73.With नि-, to dig, to dig up; 2. to bury, वसुधायां निचख्नतुः R.xii.30, Yaj.iii.1, Bt.xvi.22; 3. to fix, to implant, to pierce, निचखान शरं भुजे R.iii.55, xii.90, Bt.iii.8.With परि-, to dig round.
खनक m. 1. A miner; 2. a housebreaker; 3. a rat; 4. a mine.
खानक a. (f. निका) One who digs.
खनन n. 1. Digging, excavating; 2. burying.
खनि(नी) f. 1. A mine, R.xvii.66, xviii.22; 2. a cave.
खनि(नी) f. 1. A mine, R.xvii.66, xviii.22; 2. a cave.
खानि f. A mine.
खनित्र n. A spade, a hoe, a pick-axe.
खांडव (I) m. Sugar-candy.
खांडव (II) n. Name of a forest in kurukṣetra burnt by Agni with the assistance of Arjuna and Kṛṣṇa.
खांडव-प्रस्थ m. name of a town.
खांडविक m. A confectioner.
खांडविक m. A confectioner.
खान n. 1. Digging; 2. injury.
खान-उदक m. the cocoa-nut tree.
खानक a. (f. निका) One who digs.
खानिक m.n. A hole in a wall.
खानिल m. A house-breaker.
